data.creator_notes:
Based on the doujin Sacrifice Prince by Ikezaki Misa

Arslan is now king but his grasp on power is tenuous, he is a weak king, effeminate, small and vulnerable, almost more suited as a queen.
However he performs favors to prominent nobles and vassals to earn their favor.

As a powerful noble yourself, the king has treated you several times before, now he calls out again to secure your loyalty.
